description: Architecture diagram, left to right, wide 16:9. Far left: a rounded box labelled 'Ask Rasoi' with subtitle 'your code, instrumented once'. Inside or just below it, three small stacked pills: 'invoke_agent', 'chat', 'execute_tool'. An arrow to the right into a box labelled 'OpenTelemetry SDK' with subtitle 'spans, attributes, gen_ai.* names'. From it, one thick arrow labelled 'OTLP over HTTP' going right into a vertical bracket that fans out to five rounded boxes stacked on the right, top to bottom: 'Langfuse', 'Arize Phoenix', 'LangSmith', 'Braintrust', 'Datadog'. The first two boxes are filled light sky blue with a small tag 'run in our build'; the last three are outlined in grey only with a small tag 'same wire, not run'. Under the whole figure a thin caption line: 'Instrument once, send anywhere'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

Data model diagram, wide 16:9, clean boxes and connecting lines. Centre-left: a large rounded box labelled 'Session' with subtitle 'one conversation: gen_ai.conversation.id'. Inside it, three smaller rounded boxes side by side labelled 'Trace: turn 1', 'Trace: turn 2', 'Trace: turn 3'. Under 'Trace: turn 3', a small tree of three rows indented: 'Observation: span', 'Observation: generation', 'Observation: tool'. To the right of the session box, a green rounded box 'Score' with subtitle 'name, value, source', with thin lines connecting it to a trace and to an observation. Top right: a rounded box 'Prompt' with subtitle 'versions and labels', a line to the 'Observation: generation' row labelled 'used version'. Bottom right: a rounded box 'Dataset' containing two small boxes 'Item' and 'Item', and an arrow from Dataset to a box 'Experiment run' which links with a dashed line to a trace. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

Flow diagram, left to right, wide 16:9. Box 1: 'Pull request' with subtitle 'a one-line prompt change'. Arrow to box 2: 'GitHub Actions' with subtitle 'on every pull request'. Arrow to a larger box 3 labelled 'pytest with DeepEval' containing three stacked rows: 'Code checks on Bahi: did the order really release', 'Tool correctness: the right tools in order', 'LLM judge: plain and honest reply'. From box 3 two arrows leave to the right: the upper one, coloured sky blue, to a box 'All pass: merge allowed'; the lower one, coloured ember orange, to a box 'Any fail: merge blocked'. Under box 3 a small note 'replays recorded model calls, or calls the model with a CI key'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

Diagram of a retrieval-augmented answer and the four measurements made on it, wide 16:9. A horizontal pipeline across the middle: rounded box 'Question' then arrow to 'Retriever' then arrow to a box 'Retrieved clauses' (show three small stacked cards inside it) then arrow to 'Model' then arrow to 'Answer'. Above the pipeline a box 'Reference clauses' with subtitle 'the gold answer key'. Four green measurement labels with thin curved brackets: 'Context recall' joining Reference clauses and Retrieved clauses; 'Context precision' over Retrieved clauses; 'Faithfulness' joining Retrieved clauses and Answer; 'Response relevancy' joining Question and Answer. Small subtitle under Context recall and Context precision: 'by clause id, no model'. Small subtitle under Faithfulness: 'a model judges each claim'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

Flow diagram, left to right, wide 16:9. Left: a box 'Attack cases' containing two stacked boxes 'Plugins: what to break' (subtitle 'food-grade rule, approval limit, false done') and 'Strategies: how to deliver' (subtitle 'direct, role play, encoded, hidden in data'). Arrow labelled 'promptfoo eval' to the centre box 'Provider: Ask Rasoi' which sits above a soft ember-orange box 'Bahi sandbox, fresh for every case'. Arrow right to a box 'Assertions on Bahi state' with subtitle 'did a rule really break'. Arrow right to a final box 'Report' containing the text 'attack success rate = broken / attempted'. A thin return arrow along the bottom from Report back to Attack cases labelled 'every hit becomes a test'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

Two-loop diagram, wide 16:9. Left loop, titled 'Offline evals: before a change ships', drawn as a circle of four rounded boxes: 'Dataset of cases', 'Run the agent', 'Score with code and judges', 'Gate: ship or block'. Right loop, titled 'Online evals: after it ships', a circle of four rounded boxes: 'Production traces', 'Score a sample', 'Dashboard and alerts', 'Review the failures'. A thick arrow from the left loop's 'Gate' to the right loop's 'Production traces' labelled 'deploy'. A thick arrow from the right loop's 'Review the failures' back to the left loop's 'Dataset of cases' labelled 'a failure becomes a case'. Left loop in sky blue, right loop in green accents. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

Architecture diagram of the Ask Rasoi assistant, wide 16:9, with one layer highlighted. Top row, three small boxes: 'Ask Rasoi chat', 'Workflow Studio', 'Approvals inbox'. Below, a large rounded box 'Harness: the loop' containing two boxes 'LLM: the brain' and 'Knowledge: RAG and wiki'. Below it a thin bar 'MCP', then a box 'Toolbox: one tool per business activity', then at the bottom a soft ember-orange box 'Bahi ERP 7.2 (1998)'. Down the right side, a tall box 'Trust layer' in light grey. Down the left side, a tall box spanning from the harness to the toolbox, filled strong sky blue and clearly highlighted, labelled 'Observability and evals' with three items listed inside: 'Traces: OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Phoenix', 'Offline evals: DeepEval, Ragas, promptfoo', 'Online evals and dashboards'. Thin dotted lines from the highlighted box to the harness, the LLM, the knowledge box and the toolbox, labelled 'spans'. Everything except the highlighted box is in muted light grey. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.
